MasulloGRH.archKernel_partialFractions (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (h1 : t ≠ 1) :
  MasulloGRH.archKernel t = 1 / (t - 1) - 1 / t - 1 / t ^ 2

MasulloGRH.archKernel_subtraction (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (h1 : t ≠ 1) :
  MasulloGRH.archKernel t - 1 / (t ^ 3 * (t - 1)) = 1 / t ^ 3
'MasulloGRH.archKernel_subtraction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

MasulloGRH.resolvent_subtraction (z w r : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ r) (hw : w ≠ r) :
  1 / (z - r) - 1 / (w - r) = (w - z) / ((z - r) * (w - r))

  (hr : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < ‖r n‖) (hlarge : ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * R ≤ ‖r n‖) (hs : Summable fun n => 1 / ‖r n‖ ^ 2) :

MasulloGRH.paired_resolvent_uniform_convergence (r : ℕ → ℂ) (w : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ R) (hr : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < ‖r n‖)
  (hlarge : ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * R ≤ ‖r n‖) (hs : Summable fun n => 1 / ‖r n‖ ^ 2) :
  TendstoUniformlyOn (fun N z => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / (z - r n) - 1 / (w - r n)))
